name: VanillaOptionPricers
what_it_holds: Fast vectorized Black-Scholes-Merton and Bachelier option pricers and implied-volatility fitters (Python).
why_useful: Pricing/IV-fitting utility only; would need an actual ABNB option chain fed into it to be useful, no data of its own.
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
why_all: Pricing/IV-fitting utility only; would need an actual ABNB option chain fed into it to be useful, no data of its own.

name: Empirical-Finance
what_it_holds: Combined toolkit: Fama-French model estimation, idiosyncratic volatility construction, and event-study code in one repo (per description); likely course-derived but multi-method rather than single-ticker.
why_useful: Same event-study + factor-loader combination as above, useful reference implementation for building an ABNB/peer earnings event study with risk adjustment.
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: Same event-study + factor-loader combination as above, useful reference implementation for building an ABNB/peer earnings event study with risk adjustment.

name: getFamaFrenchFactors
what_it_holds: Small Python package that pulls Fama-French factor files directly from the Kenneth French Data Library and returns a pandas DataFrame (one-command pull, no scraping of a hostile site).
why_useful: A clean, minimal one-command loader for the exact Ken French factors we already hold; useful only as a maintenance/automation convenience, not new data.
duplicate_of_holding: We already hold Ken French factors; this is just a loader for the same public source
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: A clean, minimal one-command loader for the exact Ken French factors we already hold; useful only as a maintenance/automation convenience, not new data.

name: FamaFrenchData.jl
what_it_holds: Julia package providing programmatic access to the Ken French Data Library factor files.
why_useful: Same as getFamaFrenchFactors but in Julia; only relevant if the team ever needs a Julia pipeline.
duplicate_of_holding: Duplicate of Ken French factors we already hold
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: Same as getFamaFrenchFactors but in Julia; only relevant if the team ever needs a Julia pipeline.

name: quant-lab-alpha
what_it_holds: Open-source investment analytics platform with Fama-French 5-factor portfolio risk decomposition, block-bootstrap Monte Carlo retirement modeling, max-drawdown/CVaR dashboards, Markowitz/Ledoit-Wolf optimisation, delivered as a UI tool rather than a dataset.
why_useful: General-purpose factor/risk platform; could be repurposed to risk-decompose ABNB vs peers, but is tooling, not new data, and not earnings/event-study specific.
themes: Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: General-purpose factor/risk platform; could be repurposed to risk-decompose ABNB vs peers, but is tooling, not new data, and not earnings/event-study specific.
